scheme_name: MahaDBT – Direct Benefit Transfer for Entrepreneurs
overview: MahaDBT – Direct Benefit Transfer for Entrepreneurs is a state-level scheme in Maharashtra that facilitates the direct transfer of financial benefits to eligible entrepreneurs through the MahaDBT portal. The scheme aims to streamline the disbursement of subsidies, grants, and other financial assistance by linking beneficiary bank accounts with Aadhaar for transparent and efficient delivery. It supports various entrepreneur-focused initiatives under departments like Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship, and others, ensuring timely and traceable benefit transfers.
objectives: Ensure direct and transparent transfer of benefits to eligible entrepreneurs
Eliminate intermediaries and reduce leakage in subsidy disbursement
Link beneficiary bank accounts with Aadhaar for secure and real-time transfers
Provide a unified digital platform for applying, tracking, and managing benefits
Support skill development, employment generation, and entrepreneurship across Maharashtra
Enable real-time tracking of application status and benefit disbursement
Promote financial inclusion through Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts
Streamline renewal and re-application processes for ongoing support
eligibility: Eligibility varies by specific sub-scheme under MahaDBT, but generally requires applicants to be residents of Maharashtra, possess valid domicile and caste/income certificates where applicable, have an Aadhaar-seeded bank account, and meet the specific criteria of the benefit scheme they are applying for (e.g., income limits, educational qualifications, category-based reservations). For entrepreneur-focused schemes, applicants must be engaged in or planning to start a business venture and may need to provide project reports, registration documents, and proof of training or skill acquisition.
benefits: Benefits include direct financial transfers to bank accounts, reimbursement of tuition and exam fees, maintenance allowances, stipends for training (e.g., Rs. 500/month for ITI trainees), scholarships for professional and higher education, fee waivers, and support for skill development and entrepreneurship. Non-financial benefits include real-time application tracking, digital locker integration, grievance redressal, and access to citizen charter and helpline support.
financial_support: Financial support is transferred directly to the beneficiary’s Aadhaar-seeded bank account via the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanism. The amount and type of support depend on the specific sub-scheme (e.g., maintenance allowance, stipend, fee reimbursement, or scholarship). Payments are made in real time or monthly, as per the scheme guidelines, and beneficiaries can track disbursement status through the MahaDBT portal.
application_process: 1. Visit the MahaDBT portal at https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in. 2. Register as a new applicant using mobile number, Aadhaar, PAN, and scholarship/application ID if applicable. 3. Log in to the portal using credentials. 4. Browse or search for eligible schemes under departments like Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship, or others. 5. Select the desired scheme and click 'Apply'. 6. Fill in the application form with personal, educational, and financial details. 7. Upload required documents such as domicile, caste, income, educational certificates, and Aadhaar. 8. Submit the application and note the application ID. 9. Track application status in real time via the portal. 10. Upon approval, benefits are transferred directly to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
required_documents: Warden letter (if not in government hostel)
Registration/Application ID with GOI post matric scholarship scheme (for maintenance allowance)
CAP round allotment letter (for professional courses)
Husband Income Certificate (if girl is married)
Annual progressive report of guide (for renewal)
deadlines: Application acceptance for the new academic year A.Y. 2025–26 has commenced from 30th June 2025. Application acceptance (Fresh/Renewal) for A.Y. 2025–26 will continue until 30th June 2026. The Re-apply provision for A.Y. 2023–24 and A.Y. 2024–25 will continue until 30th June 2026.
implementing_agency: Skill Development, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department, Government of Maharashtra
contact_details: Helpline Number: 022-49150800 | Chief Minister Helpline: 24x7 (Toll Free) No.: 1800 120 8040
caveats: Beneficiary must have an Aadhaar-seeded bank account to receive benefits
Applications may be rejected if Aadhaar is not mapped to bank account via NPCI mapper
Benefits are discontinued if the beneficiary fails to meet renewal criteria (e.g., attendance, academic progress)
Only two children per family are eligible for certain schemes
Benefits are not available for distance education, virtual learning, or part-time courses
Applicants must not have availed similar benefits from government or private ITIs previously
Management quota admissions are not eligible for fee reimbursement
Beneficiary must attempt every semester or annual exam
Non-satisfactory educational progress due to misconduct or attendance failure leads to ineligibility
Account must be active and not closed, frozen, or under litigation
Aadhaar must be seeded and active in NPCI mapper for successful transaction
